name: Veigar
title: The Tiny Master of Evil

passive.name: Phenomenal Evil Power

description.normalized: Striking an enemy champion with an ability grants Veigar a stack of Phenomenal Evil. Takedowns grant an additional 5 stacks. Phenomenal Evil gives Veigar 1 ability power per stack.

passive.rawParsedText: Striking an enemy champion with an ability grants Veigar a stack of Phenomenal Evil. Takedowns grant an additional 5 stacks. Phenomenal Evil gives Veigar 1 ability power per stack.

q.name: Baleful Strike

description.normalized: Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy, dealing 65 / 125 / 185 / 245 (+55% / 60% / 65% / 70% AP) magic damage to the first two enemies hit.

q.rawParsedText: Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy, dealing 65 / 125 / 185 / 245 (+55% / 60% / 65% / 70% AP) magic damage to the first two enemies hit.

w.name: Dark Matter

description.normalized: Veigar summons dark matter from the sky, dealing100 / 160 / 220 / 280 (+95% AP) magic damage. Every 50 stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce this ability's cooldown by 10%.

w.rawParsedText:
Veigar summons dark matter from the sky, dealing100 / 160 / 220 / 280 (+95% AP) magic damage.

Every 50 stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce this ability's cooldown by 10%.

e.name: Event Horizon

description.normalized: Veigar creates a cage that stuns enemies that pass through for 1.75 / 2 / 2.25 / 2.5 seconds. The cage lasts for 3 seconds. Veigar's Dark Matter auto casts will prioritize targets stunned by Event Horizon.

r.name: Primordial Burst

description.normalized: Veigar blasts an Enemy Champion with primal magic to deal 185 / 250 / 315 (+75% AP) magic damage to them, increased by 0% - 100% based on the target's missing health. Deals max damage to enemies below 35% health.
